About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

Customer Experience

Plasma is scaling its customer-facing operations across international markets, and we’re growing the Customer Experience Team to match. You’ll join an established team and take ownership of coverage for the Central Standard Time timezone, making sure our customers get great support when they need it most.

You’ll work across the full customer journey, from first contact through to resolution. Because we’re still building out our playbook, your input will directly shape the processes, standards, and team culture as we grow. You won’t just follow the process; you’ll help refine it.

Some flexibility in working hours & weekend shifts will be needed to support coverage and the occasional busy period. We’re looking for a hard-working self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment and is committed to the mission alongside the rest of the team.

The role

  • Own the customer experience day-to-day: Be the first person our customers reach when something goes wrong or they need help. You will handle inbound queries across chat, email, and support tooling, and take accountability for the quality and speed of every response.

  • Be the right hand of the Ops lead: Work directly alongside the Head of Operations to build out processes, identify gaps, and support decisions as we scale the team internationally. This is not a back-office support role. You will be involved in how we think about operations.

  • Build the foundations: We are early. Many of the processes, templates, and escalation paths do not exist yet. You will create them. From response frameworks to internal guides, you will help lay the groundwork the team will rely on as we grow.

  • Support international team scaling: As we hire Ops team members in new markets, you will help onboard them, share knowledge, and maintain consistency in how we deliver for customers across regions.

  • Spot problems before they become patterns: Track issues across the customer base, flag recurring themes to Product and Engineering, and help prioritise fixes that actually move the needle for customers.

  • Work across teams: Collaborate with Compliance, KYC, and Product to make sure the customer experience is joined up, especially during onboarding and verification flows where things can go wrong quickly.

  • Represent the customer internally: Your proximity to customer feedback is valuable. Use it. Bring customer insight into internal conversations and push for improvements that matter.

  • Be Flexible with Shift Rotation: Most weeks you’ll work the normal Mon-Fri, however team members currently rotate weekend shifts which means that you may be required to work a weekend shift once every 6 weeks. You’ll then be able to take those days worked off the following week.

The Bar

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in customer operations, customer success, or a support role, ideally within fintech, payments, or crypto. We will consider strong candidates from outside these sectors if the fit is right.

  • Someone who takes ownership. You do not wait to be told. When something is broken or missing, you fix it or flag it. You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching.

  • Clear and direct in how you communicate. You can write a helpful, professional response under pressure and explain a complex situation simply. You know the difference between being thorough and overcomplicating things.

  • Competent English Language - our team communicates in english so being competent with the language is a requirement.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. This is an early-stage company. Processes will change, priorities will shift, and some days you will be figuring things out as you go. You see that as interesting rather than frustrating. Preferably, you have worked at a fast-paced tech company.

  • Genuinely curious about crypto. You do not need deep technical knowledge, but you need to understand the basics of how stablecoins and digital assets work and be motivated to learn more. Our customers live in this space.

  • Organised under pressure. You can manage a queue, prioritise effectively, and keep quality high when things are busy.

  • Collaborative by default. You work well with people in different functions, different time zones, and different levels of seniority. Building the team abroad means working with people you may never meet in person, and you are good at that.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up where you had to build or rebuild processes, not just follow them.

  • Exposure to Intercom, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or similar support tooling in a live production environment.

  • Any familiarity with KYC or compliance workflows as they relate to customer onboarding.

  • Experience supporting or managing a small team, even informally, or helping onboard new colleagues.

  • An interest in how stablecoin and DeFi products work and the customer challenges they create.

  • Multilingual skills that could support customer communication across our international markets.

What's in it for you

  • Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation.

  • A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad.

  • Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.

  • Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.

  • All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.

  • Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

Data Protection & Privacy
We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws.

About Dakota

Dakota is a stablecoin infrastructure platform powering modern financial products through regulated money movement, stablecoin orchestration, and cross-border settlement. We serve institutional clients — fintechs, payment service providers, marketplaces, and enterprises — through an API-first platform that abstracts the complexity of custody, compliance, settlement, and banking partnerships.

We are a remote first team across North America and Europe. We value high quality work, clear thinking and ownership.

The Role

You’ll join our Client Operations team as the first line for client questions: tracing payments, resolving exceptions, and making sure every client gets a fast, accurate response. You’ll also turn what you learn into runbooks, help center articles, and fixes, so the same problem doesn’t come back.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership. You'll work directly with our operations leadership, engineering, and compliance teams. As you build depth across our payment rails, you’ll have the chance to take on more scope and grow into more senior responsibilities.

What You'll Do

  • Own the client support queue: triage, respond, and resolve inbound questions from API and business banking clients

  • Investigate and resolve payment exceptions across wires, ACH, SWIFT, and stablecoin rails, including traces, returns, recalls, and delayed payments

  • Work with our bank partners on payment investigations

  • Keep clients updated on onboarding and account status

  • Monitor transaction activity and alerts, and flag anything unusual early

  • Write clear bug reports and feature requests so engineering can act fast

  • Build and maintain runbooks and help center articles based on real client questions

  • Spot the top recurring issues each week and push to eliminate them

What We're Looking For

  • 1–3 years in payment operations or client support at a fintech, BaaS provider, neobank, or payments company.

  • Working knowledge of wires, ACH (returns, NOCs, reversals), and SWIFT (MT103s, UETRs, intermediary banks).

  • Comfort reading API responses, transaction data, and logs to figure out what happened

  • Clear, calm writing, especially when the news isn't good

  • An instinct to fix root causes, not just close tickets

  • Sound judgment about what to handle yourself and when to escalate

  • Preference to be based in the Eastern Time (ET) zone

Nice to Have

  • Experience with stablecoins or crypto payment rails

  • Direct experience working exceptions with bank partners

  • Familiarity with Pylon, Salesforce, Linear, Datadog, KYB/C verification tools, or similar tools

  • You use AI tools daily and like building small automations

  • Exposure to KYB/KYC onboarding workflows

How We Work

At Dakota, we value people who:

  • Strive for excellence

  • Practice extreme ownership

  • Experiment fearlessly and learn quickly

  • Stay close to customers

  • Communicate clearly and directly

What We Offer

  • Engaging problems that increase economic freedom globally

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Employee-friendly equity terms (extended exercise)

  • Remote work, no commuting to the office

  • Paid co-working space/desk at an office

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Regular team events and off-sites

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Enterprise LATAM Sales team builds and expands relationships with some of the largest and most complex businesses in the region. We help enterprises modernize their financial infrastructure, launch new business models, and grow locally and globally using Stripe.

You’ll also partner closely with Solutions Architecture, Product, Risk, Legal, Marketing, and other teams to deepen Stripe’s presence across LATAM.

As Sales Manager, Enterprise — LATAM, you’ll recruit, coach, and lead a team responsible for developing new strategic relationships and expanding Stripe’s footprint within existing enterprise users. You’ll combine strong people leadership with hands-on deal coaching, disciplined business management, and a deep understanding of the Brazilian market.

  • Recruit, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Account Executives spanning Startups, SMB’s, Platforms and Large Enterprises.
  • Establish the team’s long-term vision, go-to-market strategy, and operating rhythm for LATAM.
  • Own team-level revenue, activation, pipeline, and other sales targets.

  • Develop the team’s capabilities in collaborative pipeline generation, consultative and solution-based selling, closing strategy, and MEDDIIC.
  • Help the team create and execute territory and account strategies that generate new business and expand Stripe’s footprint within existing users.
  • Provide hands-on coaching for complex opportunities, including executive engagement, deal strategy, commercial structuring, and negotiation.
  • Build trusted relationships with strategic customers, industry leaders, partners, and senior stakeholders across the region.
  • Work cross-functionally with Solutions Architecture, Product, Risk, Legal, Marketing, and other teams to develop solutions that address users’ business and technical needs.

You are a strategic, hands-on sales leader with experience building and coaching enterprise technology sales teams. You have a record of delivering strong commercial results, developing talent, and helping sellers navigate complex customer environments.

You’re a self-starting builder who is comfortable operating in an ambitious, fast-changing environment. You can move between setting regional strategy, coaching an individual seller, engaging an executive customer, and collaborating with technical and product teams.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of relevant enterprise sales experience, including experience as a successful quota-carrying Account Executive, and/or 5+ years of frontline sales-management experience in technology, SaaS, fintech, banking, payments, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and scaling a high-performing enterprise sales team.
  • A consistent record of meeting or exceeding individual or team sales targets.
  • Experience developing and executing regional, territory, and account strategies.
  • Experience coaching sellers through complex, end-to-end sales cycles involving technical, commercial, product, risk, and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with strategic customers, senior executives, industry leaders, and partners.
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience supporting complex deal strategies and negotiations.
  • Ability to understand technical requirements, communicate technical concepts clearly, and connect Stripe’s capabilities to customer value.
  • Experience partnering across functions to address complex customer needs and deliver thoughtful solutions.
  • Strong business-management skills, including pipeline inspection, forecasting, performance management, and operating cadence.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong presentation, influence, and stakeholder-management skills with senior audiences, in person and virtually.
  • Experience operating in an ambiguous, high-growth, technology-forward environment.
  • Ability to work from Stripe’s Sao Paulo office in accordance with the team’s in-office expectations.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, technical SaaS, cloud or data infrastructure, developer tools, or another complex enterprise technology.
  • Experience leading enterprise sales teams in Brazil or across multiple LATAM markets.
  • Familiarity with Brazil’s payments ecosystem and the broader financial-services landscape across LATAM.
  • Experience managing teams responsible for both new-customer acquisition and expansion within existing enterprise accounts.
  • Experience selling to retail, e-commerce, marketplaces, platforms, or other complex digital businesses.
  • Experience implementing a structured enterprise sales methodology such as MEDDIIC.
  • Experience building or scaling a sales team in a developing market.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese, English, Spanish is a plus
  • Second-line or broader organizational leadership experience.

  • Experience with fair value measurement (ASC 820 / IFRS 13) and familiarity with derivative valuation methodologies.

About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join our Post Trade Engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of our brokerage systems. You will work closely with our engineering team and other stakeholders to create scalable, low-latency, and highly available trading systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Build new products and features while supporting and enhancing existing ones, owning the technical architecture, design, and delivery of high-performance, low-latency brokerage systems using Java

Fundamental Researcher - Compute Markets

The role

  • DRW is seeking a Fundamental Researcher to develop investment views on compute markets and the infrastructure that supports them. You will research the economics of compute supply and demand, form views on the macro forces shaping the market, and translate them into investment recommendations for a compute derivatives strategy.
  • You will work alongside a quantitative researcher who owns the pricing models. Your contribution is an independent, fundamental perspective: understanding the models well enough to test their assumptions against what is happening in the market, and flagging when the market has moved ahead of them.
  • This is a founding seat on a small investment team. We are particularly interested in candidates with credit, commodities or semiconductor research experience who can apply rigorous analysis of cash flows, capacity, contracts and downside risk to a market that is still taking shape. We do not expect deep prior experience in compute. We expect strong analytical foundations and the curiosity to build sector expertise quickly.

What you'll do

  • Develop macro and fundamental views on compute. Track and interpret the forces driving supply and demand: AI training and inference demand, hyperscaler and neocloud capital expenditure, chip supply and generational transitions, data center capacity, power availability, financing conditions and policy, including export controls.
  • Translate pricing into investment views. Assess what compute pricing across contract terms and chip generations implies about demand, capacity and scarcity. Identify where prices diverge from fundamentals and recommend how to express those views.
  • Validate pricing assumptions. Develop a working understanding of the pricing models and supply the fundamental evidence behind their key inputs, including supply pipeline, utilization, workload mix and the pace of price declines across hardware generations. Challenge those inputs when the evidence changes.
  • Build research models. Develop supply-and-demand balances, unit economics and scenarios that connect fundamental drivers to compute pricing and investment outcomes, with assumptions documented and testable.
  • Assess counterparties and assets with a credit investor's discipline. Evaluate revenue quality, utilization, cost structure, customer concentration, contractual commitments, leverage, liquidity and refinancing risk. Examine how generational turnover and the falling cost of compute affect asset values, counterparty resilience and recoveries.
  • Make clear recommendations. Present to the Portfolio Manager and Investment Committee, setting out the investment thesis, valuation framework, catalysts, risks and the evidence that would change the view.
  • Build differentiated information sources. Develop a network of industry contacts and data sources across hardware, cloud, data center and power markets to test assumptions and spot inflections early.

What we're looking for

  • 5 to 7 years of fundamental investment research experience, ideally in credit research or investing (including structured or asset-backed finance), commodities (particularly power and energy), or buy-side or sell-side coverage of semiconductors and digital infrastructure.
  • A demonstrated ability to turn complex or incomplete information into a clear investment judgment.
  • Strong financial modeling skills and a thorough understanding of cash flow analysis, capital structures and downside scenarios.
  • Enough quantitative fluency to engage with pricing models: understand how they work, interrogate their inputs and judge whether their outputs are consistent with the market. You will not be expected to build or maintain them.
  • An understanding of how a fundamental view translates into a derivatives position such as a forward or swap, or the ability to learn this quickly.
  • The ability to distinguish structural trends from temporary supply-and-demand imbalances and to assess what is already reflected in pricing.
  • A strong interest in compute markets and the drive to build expertise across hardware, cloud services, data centers and power infrastructure. Prior experience in the sector is valuable but not required.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, intellectual independence, and a willingness to challenge assumptions and revise views as evidence changes.
